history.name: DataExtraction_Expert
history.content:
Task: Determine the number of Rick Riordan books not currently on the shelves (i.e., statuses indicating not present on shelves).
Plan:
- Extract full text from the PDF and parse records. Each book record appears as 5 lines: Title, Author, Publisher, Genre, Status, with category headers interspersed (to be skipped).
- Filter rows where Author == Rick Riordan.
- Treat 'Checked Out' and 'Overdue' as not on shelves. If 'On Hold' or 'In Processing' exists, include them as not on shelves too.
- Verify there are no duplicates and tally the count.
CSVHandling_Expert, please parse the entire PDF into a DataFrame and report the Rick Riordan titles with their statuses and the count of those not on shelves.

history.name: CSVHandling_Expert
history.content:
I will extract the PDF text, parse book records centered around lines where the author equals 'Rick Riordan', and compute the count for statuses not on shelves (Checked Out, Overdue).

Code to run:

```python
from functions import extract_pdf_text
import pandas as pd

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split('\n') if ln.strip()]

riordan_rows = []
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.lower() == 'rick riordan':
        # Expect pattern: Title (i-1), Author (i), Publisher (i+1), Genre (i+2), Status (i+3)
        try:
            title = lines[i-1]
            publisher = lines[i+1]
            genre = lines[i+2]
            status = lines[i+3]
            riordan_rows.append([title, 'Rick Riordan', publisher, genre, status])
        except IndexError:
            pass

riordan_df = pd.DataFrame(riordan_rows, columns=['Title','Author','Publisher','Genre','Status'])

not_on_shelves = {'checked out','overdue','on hold','in processing'}
riordan_df['status_norm'] = riordan_df['Status'].str.lower()
riordan_not_on_shelves = riordan_df[riordan_df['status_norm'].isin(not_on_shelves)]

print("Rick Riordan titles and statuses:\n", riordan_df[['Title','Status']].to_string(index=False))
print("\nNumber not on shelves:", len(riordan_not_on_shelves))
```
